name: Direct Claude and Grok Bot app headless client
capability: Reuses shared credential custody directly for Claude child-process OAuth and the existing Grok Bot app HTTPS coordinator: agent discovery, explicit prompts, transcripts, attachment reads and exact-byte uploads. No new vault, peer grant or holder session.
next_gap: Existing peer processes must import current source to use the new API. CI makes no live provider or model calls; owner-session service receipts remain separate from source tests.
